"""Intent tests for risk.log_returns (M1-T16, RISK-01, TC-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import Prices
from risk import Returns, log_returns


def _prices(data: dict) -> Prices:
    return Prices(
        dates=tuple(data["dates"]),
        tickers=tuple(data["tickers"]),
        closes={t: tuple(v) for t, v in data["closes"].items()},
    )


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc04_geometric_closes_give_the_closed_form_log_returns(golden):
    data, expected = golden("risk", "TC-04")
    returns = log_returns(_prices(data["prices"]))
    assert isinstance(returns, Returns)
    assert returns.base_date == expected["base_date"]
    assert returns.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert returns.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(returns.values) == set(expected["values"])
    for ticker, values in expected["values"].items():
        assert list(returns.values[ticker]) == pytest.approx(values, abs=expected["tol"], rel=0)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_returns_are_dated_after_the_base_date_one_per_ticker_and_date(golden):
    data, _ = golden("risk", "TC-04")
    prices = _prices(data["prices"])
    returns = log_returns(prices)
    assert returns.base_date == prices.dates[0]
    assert returns.dates == prices.dates[1:]
    for ticker in prices.tickers:
        assert len(returns.values[ticker]) == len(prices.dates) - 1


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_contract_sample_prices_give_the_contract_sample_returns(contract_sample):
    prices = _prices(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))

    assert returns.dates == tuple(sample["dates"])
